statement: Exact opened comparison theorems distinguish full, procongruence, cutting-compatible and torsion-action groups; none supplies the missing frame parity or involution conjugacy by itself.
depends_on: Drinfeld section4; Minamide–Nakamura TheoremB; Hoshi–Minamide–Mochizuki CorollariesB,C; Boggi2026v6 TheoremsA,B; Lochak–Nakamura–Schneps2026 Theorem1.1 section8; Lochak–Schneps1997 Proposition3 Theorem2; Collas2012 TheoremsA–D
notes: All named primary texts used in this statement were opened; each reduction is written and completion hypotheses retained.

statement: The continuous abelianization splits canonically into the multiplier and an arithmetic-trivial factor; finite characters decompose accordingly. R24 gives a nonzero quadratic factor for GT0, while the factor for GT and its Delta restriction remain undetermined. The exact literature antecedents of torsion frames and extra special-locus relations are recorded.
depends_on: Kronecker–Weber; R24; R25; P.1; Collas2012; Schneps2006 Theorems3.1,3.4; Ihara2000 Theorem1 Propositions1–3; Marin2008 section4
notes: No priority claim. R25 gives finite-subgroup bound and full negative multiplier, not conjugacy. The full original NT2003 remains an access gap. NTY2010 has now been opened and its exact arithmetic scope is recorded in P.8. C.23 now constructs the nonzero arithmetic-trivial character Delta+DeltaD; independence from Delta is not claimed.

statement: NTY2010 Theorem4.16 gives the exact equianharmonic CM beta specialization, including the central sign and Kummer shear, on the Galois image; its braid formulas do not assert validity on all GT.
notes: Full18-page primary paper opened from the author-uploaded copy. The remaining original NT2003 access gap is distinct. No priority claim.
